title: Round 17: round 15's copies arm continued with copies outweighing stock competitors
description: On every validation family against net1 v6's rule, round 15's copies arm clears both competition conditions (cubic-first-60 +0.174, new-20 competition +0.085, exp-net2-eval-v6-159) but loses 0.300 as copies, and its three seeds as one policy on their mean u still lose 0.258 (exp-net2-eval-v6-ens-160): the push among copies is shared by the seeds, not a seed's misfire. Where a full queue with a low share looks the same to net1 whether copies or a loss-based flow fill it, the shared policy's best action follows how often each case occurs in training, and round 15 held copies and stock flows at one to one. Round 17 continues round 15's copies arm (actor and critic, release model-net2-r15-state, by seed) with the same mixture (alone 0.35, compete 0.6) but copies on two thirds or four fifths of the competition links (PPOSpec copies_share 0.67 and 0.8, against 0.5), trading some of its large competition margin for copies. Seeds 1 to 3, 120 iterations, tau 1 s, 30 s episodes. Validation links only.
prepare: (cd "$IN/a" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); N="$IN/v6/net1-v6-s0/net1.pt"; uv run python experiments/net2_ppo_setup.py "$OUT/setup" --net1 "$N" --models "$IN/models" --u 0.25 --paths net2-train-xl
run: S="$OUT/spec-r17-cs$CS-s$SEED.json"; A="$IN/a/ppo-r15-copies-s$SEED"; jq --argjson cs "$CS" --argjson seed "$SEED" --arg actor "$A.actor.pt" --arg critic "$A.critic.pt" '.algo = "ppo" | .base = "fixed" | .copies_reward = "team" | .critic_flows = true | .noise_sigma = 0.2 | .noise_hold_steps = 20 | .tau_s = 1 | .group = 4 | .links_per_iteration = 8 | .lr = 0.0003 | .alone = 0.35 | .compete = 0.6 | .copies = [2, 4] | .copies_share = $cs | .competition = "diverse" | .seed = ($seed + 100) | .iterations = 120 | .eval_every = 20 | .init_actor = $actor | .init_critic = $critic' "$OUT/setup/ppo-base.json" > "$S"; uv run expliccit train ppo "$S" "$OUT/ppo-r17-cs$CS-s$SEED" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS"
